{{Quote|The ''Jedi Council Chamber''! If ''Master Kenobi'' finds me up here, he'll kill me. Or worse&mdash;''lecture'' me!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Temple of Phantoms">{{SWComicCite|7.9|Temple of Phantoms}}</ref>}}
The '''Jedi Council Chamber''' was a circular throne room at the summit of the [[High Council Tower/Legends|High Council Tower]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It hosted meetings of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] during the rule of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TPM" /> While the Tower and chamber were destroyed during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Reconstruction Authority]] [[New Jedi Temple|rebuilt]] the Temple in [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], seeing the Tower and chamber rebuilt as they had been in the days of the Old Republic.<ref name="LOTFBL" />

==History==
===Old Republic===
[[File:Council1.jpg|thumb|250px||left|Jedi Council Chamber on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] circa [[3963 BBY]]; its earliest known incarnation.]]
Chambers for the High Council had existed on Coruscant since before [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. While the Jedi Temple that the [[Four Masters/Legends|Four Masters]] had erected was being expanded, the Council met at the top of a lone tower, which stood in the center of a broad plaza as of [[3963 BBY]]. It was at this time that the august body reassigned a [[First WatchCircle|group]] of [[Jedi Consular|Jedi seers]] to separate stations after they were unable to capture [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]], the supposed criminal behind the [[Padawan Massacre]].<ref name="KOTOR9">[[Knights of the Old Republic 9|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 9]]</ref> Only a [[3960 BBY|few years later]] the same group of Masters would [[Trial of Meetra Surik|try]] and exile a [[Meetra Surik|female knight]] who had participated in the [[Mandalorian Wars]] under the banner of the [[Revanchist]]s. Following the trial, the [[Jedi Civil War]] broke out, causing problems for the Council. While the Jedi and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] succeeded in defeating the leaders of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], fragments of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] continued to harass the Order. In [[3954 BBY]] the [[Sith Triumvirate]] began a [[First Jedi Purge|Jedi Purge]]. Abandoning the Council Spire on Coruscant, the remaining Jedi Masters were mostly hunted down and killed.<ref name="KOTORII">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

[[File:Jedicouncil4000bby.png|thumb|250px||right|Jedi Council Chamber on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] circa [[3960 BBY]].]]
After the end of the Purge and the rebuilding of the Order by the once exiled Jedi, the Council Spire and chamber were added onto the steadily expanding Jedi Temple. While the Council made use of this location for several centuries, it was ultimately destroyed by the resurgent [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] when a group of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Sacking of Coruscant|ransacked]] Coruscant.<ref name="Timeline 1" /> Unlike the last rebuilding, the Order would not have the funds to complete a massive reconstruction for several millennia. After over a thousand years of fundraising and rebuilding, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] was finally able to raise enough tax money to finish the Council Spires by [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

===Rise of the Empire===
The High Council would hold meetings within this newly built chamber for the next thousand years. Hundreds of masters would sit on the esteemed Council over the centuries, including [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="ROTS" /> Over the years, the Council held their [[The Gathering (Jedi High Council)|meetings]] not only in this chamber but throughout the Temple including the [[Room of a Thousand Fountains/Legends|Room of a Thousand Fountains]] and private quarters.<ref name="TCT">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Captive Temple]]''</ref>

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], after a [[Incident at the Jedi Temple|series of robberies]] and attacks at the Temple, Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] confronted the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Xanatos]] in the Council Chamber. As the Temple furnace was rigged to explode, the Dark Jedi [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|attacked]] Jinn in hopes that the Jedi would not figure out his plot before it was too late. Leaping through the chamber's high windows, Xanatos dueled with Jinn out on the [[High Council Tower/Legends#Meditation Station|meditation balcony]]. Realizing Xanatos' plot, Jinn fled down the stairs of the Tower and saved the Temple, though Xanatos was able to escape.<ref name="TCT" />

[[File:UnidentifiedClan-RotS.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Jedi Council Chamber becomes the scene of the slaughter of many younglings during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Council Chamber would host war meetings and discussions tended to get more heated rather than productive.<ref name="Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith novelization">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'' novel)]]</ref> During the hunt for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], leader of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], the Council convened to try and exile the young [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Codi Ty]] after he defied the Council's wishes by attempting to assassinate the dreaded [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]].<ref name="General Grievous 4">[[General Grievous 4|''General Grievous'' 4]]</ref>

At the conclusion of the war [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], known as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine to all but his closest advisors, ordered the destruction of the Jedi Order through a military operation known as [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Knightfall]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] led the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] into the Temple and began to systematically slaughter its occupants. Having secured the [[Jedi beacon/Legends|Jedi beacon]], Vader made his way to the top of the High Council Spire. Within the Council Chamber, a [[Unidentified Clan|group]] of [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] had taken refuge from the onslaught in the levels below. Begging the former Jedi for assistance, the younglings gathered around the Sith Lord before he cut them down in cold blood.<ref name="ROTS" />
The room would be cleared of the bodies by the surviving [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and burned on the steps of the public entrance to the Temple.<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Into the Unknown">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Into the Unknown]]''</ref>

===Galactic Empire===
[[File:High_Council_Chamber_Darth_Vader.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] stands in the now-empty Jedi Council Chamber a few months after the [[Declaration of a New Order]].]]
Following the abandonment of the Temple the chamber saw no use as the Jedi Council was dissolved. A few months after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Vader was forced to return to the Jedi Council Chamber, alongside Lieutenant Laurita Tohm, to access records of an event regarding the disappearance of several rogue padawans that Skywalker had arrested, and learned of the location of the [[The Prism|Ghost Prison]]. Shortly after learning this and their keeping it a secret from both him and Palpatine, Vader, furious at the council's decision to hide it from him, largely wrecked the Council Chamber with the Force. At some point later, ex-Jedi Padawan [[Ferus Olin]] entered that Spire's [[Jedi Temple/Legends|atrium]] through a rooftop [[Jedi Temple refectory/Legends|breakfast room]] and entered into a [[Duel in the Jedi Temple (Ferus Olin)|lightsaber duel]] with Darth Vader who was awaiting Olin. Climbing the ancient stairs that led to the summit of the Tower, Olin and the Sith entered the once prestigious room to continue the duel, using the chairs and floor tiles as projectiles. After striking a blow on Vader's chest plate, Olin dove through a hole in the floor, dropping several stories to the [[High Council holomap room/Legends|map room]]. Vader soon followed, leaving the chamber to lie in silence for several years.<ref name="LJR">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Reckoning]]''</ref>

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], during the [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]] [[Galen Marek|Starkiller's]] [[Starkiller's Trial of the Spirit|third mission]] to the Temple, the assassin entered the ruined chamber after cutting his way through countless [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|Shadow Troopers]] that guarded the chamber's turbolift. The malfunctioning [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] program activated as Starkiller entered the room, using the Council Chamber's holoprojectors to create a simulacrum of dead Jedi [[Kento Marek]]. Further reeking havoc in the room, Starkiller defeated the simulacrum and left the chamber in increased distress.<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

The Temple would survive for much of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Council Chamber leering over the surface of Coruscant for years. The ancient edifice was even re-inhabited briefly, as members of the [[new Jedi Order]] searched the destroyed hall for any information on the teachings of the old Order.<ref name="BRS">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref> It wasn't until several years later that the five towers of the Temple collapsed, the Council chamber completely destroyed. The new Order would clear the rubble away and erect a [[Jedi Headquarters|small praxeum]] in their place on the roof of the Ziggurat;<ref name="Star Wars: Union">''[[Star Wars: Union]]''</ref> though this too would be lost during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>

===Reconstruction===
Following the retaking of Coruscant by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]] donated a [[New Jedi Temple|new Temple]] to the Order in recognition of the Jedi's efforts during the war. Using blueprints salvaged from the old Archives the [[Reconstruction Authority]] erected the new Temple to near-exact specifications; though a new [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] pyramid concealed the restored Council towers.<ref name="FOTJO">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>

Known also as the '''Masters' Chamber''', the old room looked much as it had during the time of the Old Republic barring the addition of a small desk for the secretary of the Council. This desk would later be removed as the Council returned to the old style of simply recording the audio of the proceedings.<ref name="LOTFBL" />

During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] Knight [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] entered the empty Council Chamber and [[Flow-walking|flow-walked]] back to the night that his grandfather, Anakin Skywalker, stood before the Council and was denied the rank of Master. This event helped convince Solo to become a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] after concluding that his ancestor's motivations differed from his. [[43 ABY|Two years]] later the chamber would host a gathering of the Council, as well as other Masters of the Order, in which Interim [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Kenth Hamner]] announced his decision to subtly subvert the Alliance government and increase support for the Jedi through different media opportunities. During this meeting, several additional chairs were brought up to the chamber in order to accommodate all the Masters on Coruscant.<ref name="FOTJOT">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>

When the Order became locked in debate between the Alliance on who should take custody of the Jedi Knights who were beset with an [[Force psychosis|enigmatic madness]] the Council Chamber were guarded by two apprentices, male Human and a female [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], along with Knight [[Jaden Korr]]. These guards were thwarted by the manipulating mouth of Knight [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], who forced Korr to allow her to speak to the Council.<ref name="FOTJA">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>

==Layout==
[[File:Dk_council.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The layout of the Council Chamber, viewable to Jedi from all terminals in the First Wing of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]].]]
Located at the peak of the southeast tower of the Temple, this circular chamber granted its occupants a rare glimpse of Coruscant. The Chamber itself existed in several incarnations over the years as the Temple grew, expanded, moved, and relocated. However, the room has always kept the basic circular shape accessed by a single turbolift, high arching windows, and a ring of twelve cushioned chairs for the members of the august body. Each of the stone seats were equipped with a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] that could be used when a Council member was attending the meeting from a distant world.<ref name="ROTS" />

One of the earliest versions of the Council Chamber, erected c.[[3976 BBY]], was at the summit of a lone tower that stood at the center of a broad plaza. The simple chamber was equipped with a holoprojector capable of displaying images in the center of the room, as the Council did during the examination of the [[Padawan Massacre]].<ref name="KOTOR9" /> This room would soon be abandoned in favor of another domed room located near another tower. Similar to the previous meeting room the chamber was made of dark stone with a large, polished rock at the center of the circle. It was here that the Council banished the [[Revanchist]] [[Meetra Surik]], who had returned to Coruscant after the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. At the end of the trial, Surik drove her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] into the center stone and left the Chamber indefinitely. Several years after this event the Chamber would be lost as the [[Sith Triumvirate]] began the [[First Jedi Purge]].<ref name="KOTORII" />

[[File:No_Longer_Pristine.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The Council floor, which had once been polished regularly, showed signs of poor upkeep and constant use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]
The room would come into exist in its final, most recognizable form after the Temple expansion of [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. Erected atop the Council Spire of the Temple, the chamber was ringed by a small corridor set between the inner and outer sets of transparisteel windows which granted a panoramic view of the cityscape.<ref name="SWCL" /> The hall was accessible only to the members of the High Council and led down into the secured [[treasury room]].<ref name="TCT" /> A dedicated turbolift ran up the side of the Tower to deposit Jedi summoned by the Council into a small [[larmalstone]] lobby which served as entry into the vaulted chamber.<ref name="FOTJA" /> This turbolift was specially crafted with Force-inspired dynamics in order to accommodate Jedi of different species and size. The floor was decorated with a natural and circular motif symbolizing harmony and balance between the Jedi, the Council, and the Force. Incorporated into the five pillars spread around the room were the supports and wiring for the reception/transmission antennas that crowned the spire. These antennas were responsible for feeding data to [[Jedi command/Legends|Jedi Command]].<ref name="SWCL" />

When the Temple was rebuilt in [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], the room was restored to appear like it had for centuries during the Old Republic. However great, opulent drapes were hung over the windows and a desk was installed for use by the Secretary of the Council. However, both features were removed due to the pompousness of the drapes and the outmoding of the Secretary position.<ref name="LOTFBL" />
